title: Utility Service Work Order Form
subtitle: An original utility service workflow that controls authorized field work from dispatch through return to service, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete utility service work order form for the electric, gas, water, or thermal utility service point that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a qualified crew receives a defined task and must preserve asset identity, work limits, energy-control references, as-found evidence, work performed, testing, exceptions, and operations handoff. The utility service coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Utility service work order identity and dispatch
sections.guidance: Issue a traceable order with clear ownership, site contacts, and approved work limits.

sections.title: Utility service asset context, scope, and resources
sections.guidance: Match the order to the exact electric, gas, water, or thermal utility service point and define work that is included and excluded.

blocks.label: Authorized task scope
items: Verify account, premise, commodity, meter, and service-point identity
Confirm scope ownership between utility and customer equipment
Coordinate interruption, dispatch, traffic, access, and customer notices
Establish site-specific energy, pressure, flow, and public controls
Inspect or service only the authorized utility asset and connection
Record as-found condition, service values, and device status
Complete approved repair, replacement, adjustment, or connection work
Perform authorized leak, electrical, pressure, flow, or functional verification
Record as-left configuration, seals, labels, readings, and photos
Restore service through operations control and confirm customer handoff

blocks.label: Scope, exclusions, parts, and completion criteria

fields.label: Approved work, explicit exclusions, required parts or tools, evidence expected, and completion criteria

sections.title: Utility service pre-work controls and authorization
sections.guidance: Do not begin intrusive work until hazards, system effects, isolation ownership, and test authority are explicit.

blocks.label: Pre-work authorization confirmations
items: Exact asset, boundaries, sources, and affected systems were identified
Site-specific procedure and applicable requirements were reviewed
Authorized and affected people, roles, and communications were confirmed
Electrical, mechanical, pressure, thermal, chemical, gravity, and stored energy were assessed
Isolation devices and personal or group controls remain under designated ownership
Stored or residual energy was controlled and verification evidence was recorded
Test or temporary re-energization steps and authority are explicit
Public, customer, traffic, environmental, and critical-load controls are in place

blocks.label: Energy-control and qualified-person boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not use this record to approach downed conductors, investigate a gas odor, enter flooded electrical areas, operate unknown valves or switches, or bypass dispatch control. Keep people clear, use the organization's emergency route, and allow only qualified and authorized personnel to isolate, test, repair, and restore the affected utility service. This work order records references and decisions; it does not replace the site's energy-control procedure. Unknown, changed, or reaccumulating energy is a stop condition until the designated authorized person re-establishes and verifies control.

sections.title: Utility service work execution and test evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually done, by whom, against which task, and with what result.

blocks.label: As-left readings and test results
blocks.guidance: Record method, instrument, operating state, and acceptance reference in linked evidence when needed.

fields.label: Unexpected conditions, approved changes, temporary measures, test context, and evidence links

sections.title: Utility service exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Gas odor, hissing, suspected leak, or atmosphere concern
Downed conductor, arcing, exposed electrical part, or burn damage
Major water release, flooding, washout, or energized equipment in water
Steam, pressure, hot surface, rotating equipment, or uncontrolled stored energy
Traffic, excavation, unstable surface, animal, or uncontrolled public exposure
Unknown valve, switch, disconnect, cross-connection, or service ownership
Critical-load impact or service interruption without operations authorization
Condition requiring emergency dispatch or work beyond assigned qualification
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not use this record to approach downed conductors, investigate a gas odor, enter flooded electrical areas, operate unknown valves or switches, or bypass dispatch control. Keep people clear, use the organization's emergency route, and allow only qualified and authorized personnel to isolate, test, repair, and restore the affected utility service.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each work order exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Utility service decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Electric, gas, water, or thermal utility service point identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
